LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Enabled_Tooltip: Whether highstorms occur. When disabled, no highstorms are scheduled.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Pushing_Tooltip: Highstorms push exposed pawns and items across the land.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Damage_Tooltip: Highstorms harm visitors and animals caught in the open.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_Interval_Tooltip: Set the minimum and maximum number of days between highstorms.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_MinInterval_Toolti: Minimum number of days between highstorms.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_MaxInterval_Toolti: Maximum number of days between highstorms.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Highstorm_EnableWeeping_Tool: Highstorms cease during the final 14 days of each year.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_Stormlight_EnablePawnGlow_To: Whether pawns glow while holding Stormlight.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_AverageTicks_Label: Average time to seek a bond
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_AverageTicks_Toolt: How long a true spren usually waits before seeking someone to bond.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MinimumTicks_Label: Earliest time to seek a bond
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MinimumTicks_Toolt: The shortest time a true spren waits before seeking someone to bond.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MaximumTicks_Label: Latest time to seek a bond
LanguageData.CR_Settings_NahelBond_MaximumTicks_Toolt: The longest time a true spren waits before seeking someone to bond.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_LesserSpren_Enabled_Tooltip: Whether the game renders lesser spren particles. Lesser spren remain capturable when disabled.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_LesserSpren_MaximumZoom_Tool: The zoom level beyond which lesser spren particles no longer render.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_IdealProgression_Difficulty_: Multiplier for Ideal progression requirements. Lower values ease advancement. Higher values make it harder.
LanguageData.CR_Settings_IdealProgression_ShowRequire: Display the requirements a Radiant must meet to speak the next Ideal.
